summary: Comprehensive backend + mobile frontend testing for the Circles rebuild. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases passed (100%) covering auth, onboarding, circles CRUD + join/leave/members/events, feed public-fallback, posts (create/like/comment/delete + permission checks), conversations (auto-created circle chats + idempotent direct), live rooms lifecycle + messages, wallet buy/gift (incl. insufficient-funds + unknown gift), moderation (403 for non-mods, 200 for guide), and multipart image upload + public /api/files serve. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login → onboarding routing works, guide → tabs works. Home feed renders posts with Like/Comment, FAB opens composer with per-circle selector + Publish. Discover shows search, category chips, circle cards with Join/Joined. Circle detail shows cover, member count, Join button and Posts/Events/About tabs. Live Rooms list + Room detail with LIVE badge, host, chat input/send/mic/leave. Messages inbox auto-populates circle chats on first open; direct chat send round-trips (bubble appears instantly with timestamp). Wallet shows balance, Buy Coins increments balance (510→630) and adds a transaction. Profile shows avatar, Wallet shortcut, My circles, Moderation queue, Sign out. No red screens, no deprecated packages detected, no console errors beyond expected 401 on cold API.

issues: Header shows generic 'Chat' instead of the conversation title/avatar; both circle group chats and 1:1 DMs look identical in header. Consider rendering conversation.title + avatar.
Top gradient header area is empty on mobile (no 'Circles' wordmark visible on login/register). Minor branding polish.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely originates from a RN component (or expo-image/overlay) somewhere in the app. Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Optional UX: pass the conversation title/avatar into app/chat/[id].tsx header instead of static 'Chat'.
Optional polish: render 'Circles' wordmark on top of login/register gradient header for brand consistency.
Investigate the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN warning and switch any `pointerEvents` prop usage to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1080 lines and starting to warrant a split into routers (auth, circles, posts, conversations, rooms, wallet, moderation, uploads). Not blocking v1 but recommended before adding more features.
GET /api/users/{user_id} is defined after /api/users/me which is correct; however /api/circles/{circle_id} is defined after /api/circles — fine, but add explicit uuid validation if desired.

/api/files/{path:path} is intentionally public (good for expo-image). Confirm this matches product requirement; no auth means any guessed path returns the object — mitigate by relying on uuid obscurity (currently fine).
Feed public fallback is good UX; consider also including it alongside joined-circle posts rather than only when empty, so onboarded users with few circles still see a lively feed.
No pagination on feed/posts/comments/messages — fine for seed scale, add before scale.
seed_data_creation: Tests register random TEST_<uuid>@circles.app users and create TEST_Circle_* circles; posts/comments/messages/transactions carry 'TEST' prefix. Startup seed (6 public circles, guide, demo, one post per circle, 1 live room) is used read-only where possible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. All routes under /api, JWT bearer. Guide (moderator, onboarded): guide@circles.app / circles123. Demo (not onboarded): demo@circles.app / demo1234. Login submit testID is `login-submit` (not `login-submit-button`). Explore tab = /explore with testIDs circle-{id}, join-{id}, circle-search, cat-{Category}, create-circle. Live tab = /live with testIDs start-room, room-{id}. Chat screen testIDs: chat-input, chat-send, header-back. Room detail testIDs: room-chat-input, room-chat-send, room-mic, room-leave. Wallet buys use buy-120/700/1600. Composer testIDs: composer-close, composer-text, composer-publish, add-photo, post-to-{circle_id}. Home testIDs: create-post-fab, home-live, home-profile, post-{id}, like-{id}, comment-{id}. All 25 pytest cases are idempotent and safe to re-run.
rca_of_issue: No bug to RCA — this was an MVP validation pass and everything in scope works end-to-end.
